boards.school_name: California Polytechnic State University-San Luis Obispo
boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-cost campus and San Luis Obispo activities, including gardens, galleries, recreation, public art, and virtual exploration.

cards.title: Wander a Five-Acre Mediterranean Garden
cards.subtitle: A free year-round display garden on the Cal Poly campus
cards.notes: Bring a friend for a slow garden walk, compare the regional plant collections, and pause at the elevated campus and mountain viewpoints.
cards.short_summary: Explore student-built landscapes representing Mediterranean-climate regions without paying admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly states that the five-acre Leaning Pine Arboretum welcomes visitors year-round and charges no admission fee.
cards.access_notes: Open 8 a.m.–5 p.m. Monday–Saturday except academic holidays; visitors are welcome and no admission fee is charged.

cards.title: Browse the University Art Gallery
cards.subtitle: Rotating exhibitions inside Dexter Building 34
cards.notes: Check the exhibition schedule, meet at Dexter Building’s ground-floor gallery, and give everyone time to discuss one work that catches their eye.
cards.short_summary: See changing exhibitions by students and visiting artists in a compact campus gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly identifies the University Art Gallery in Dexter Building 34 and states that its exhibitions are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Free and open to the public; the gallery's current visit page lists regular hours as 11 a.m.–4 p.m. Tuesday–Saturday.

cards.entity_name: The Lounge at the University Union
cards.title: Settle In for Games or Conversation
cards.subtitle: A free-use campus-community room in University Union 119
cards.notes: Claim a table for board games, conversation, or a shared study sprint; use the indoor and outdoor seating without needing to order anything.
cards.short_summary: Meet in a bright, purchase-free room furnished for studying, relaxing, and tabletop play.
cards.evidence_claim: ASI describes The Lounge as a free-use space for Cal Poly students and the campus community, with seating, games, and a community library.
cards.source_title: Discover The Lounge at The University Union
cards.access_notes: Located in University Union Building 65, Room 119; check current ASI facility hours before visiting because schedules can change during breaks.

cards.title: Climb the Tower and Boulder
cards.subtitle: Student climbing with loaner shoes and harnesses included
cards.notes: Check in at the Rental Center, choose bouldering or top-rope climbing, and wear flexible clothes suitable for the provided harness and shoes.
cards.short_summary: Try two climbing formats with required equipment supplied at no charge to eligible students.
cards.evidence_claim: ASI states that currently enrolled Cal Poly students and Recreation Center members climb free, with climbing shoes and harnesses provided.
cards.access_notes: Currently enrolled students climb free after checking in; review current facility status because the outdoor park closes in wet weather and may close seasonally.

cards.title: Build a Pick-Up Recreation Session
cards.subtitle: Free-use equipment and exercise spaces for eligible campus users
cards.notes: Check field and facility status, gather friends, and select an available indoor or outdoor area for an informal game or self-directed workout.
cards.short_summary: Use ASI-managed recreation areas and shared equipment for an unstructured group activity.
cards.evidence_claim: ASI's Open Recreation page invites participants to use free-use equipment and indoor or outdoor exercise spaces.
cards.access_notes: Free-use spaces are within ASI-managed facilities; verify Recreation Center eligibility, operating hours, field status, and any reservation rules before arriving.

cards.entity_name: Cal Poly Recreation Center Group Fitness
cards.title: Take a Complimentary Fitness Class
cards.subtitle: Included group sessions for eligible Recreation Center users
cards.notes: Choose a class that matches the group’s comfort level, confirm the live schedule, and arrive early enough to handle check-in or capacity limits.
cards.short_summary: Move together in an included instructor-led class rather than organizing a workout yourselves.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Recreation Center page lists complimentary group fitness classes among the facility's amenities.
cards.access_notes: Complimentary classes are for eligible Recreation Center users; consult the current class schedule and check-in requirements before attending.

cards.entity_name: San Luis Obispo Museum of Art
cards.title: Compare Notes at SLOMA
cards.subtitle: An admission-free contemporary art museum beside Mission Plaza
cards.notes: Pick one current exhibition to explore together, then regroup in Mission Plaza and trade observations about a work each person selected.
cards.short_summary: Turn a downtown museum visit into a relaxed visual-art conversation without buying a ticket.
cards.evidence_claim: San Luis Obispo's official tourism organization states that SLOMA is always admission-free and presents regional, national, and international artists.
cards.source_title: The San Luis Obispo Museum of Art (SLOMA)
cards.access_notes: Always admission-free; the official listing says the museum is open 11 a.m.–5 p.m. and closed Tuesday and Wednesday. Confirm holiday changes.

cards.title: Roll a Session at SLO Skate Park
cards.subtitle: A free public skate facility at Santa Rosa Park
cards.notes: Bring your own skateboard or skates and appropriate protective gear, agree on a meetup point, and ride within your ability around other users.
cards.short_summary: Share an all-ages skate session at a city facility with no use charge or entry gate.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of San Luis Obispo says use of SLO Skate Park is completely free and that the unfenced facility is accessible to all as a public park.
cards.access_notes: Free public use; the city lists daily hours of 7 a.m.–10 p.m. Bring your own equipment and follow posted facility rules.

cards.title: Follow the First-Friday Art Walk
cards.subtitle: A free monthly self-guided route through downtown SLO
cards.notes: Download the month’s venue map, choose a compact cluster of participating galleries, and set a final meeting point before the group starts walking.
cards.short_summary: Explore changing exhibitions, performances, and community spaces on a recurring downtown route.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of San Luis Obispo describes Art After Dark as a free self-guided art walk held on the first Friday of each month.
cards.access_notes: Free, all-ages activity scheduled for the first Friday of each month from 5–8 p.m.; consult the monthly map because participating venues vary.

cards.title: Tour Cal Poly From the Couch
cards.subtitle: A free online campus visit for everyone
cards.notes: Open the on-demand tour on a shared screen, pause at familiar campus locations, and let each person add a story or future stop to the route.
cards.short_summary: Explore campus buildings and academic areas together when an in-person meetup is impractical.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly's official virtual-visit page labels the experience free and open to everyone and provides an on-demand campus tour.
cards.source_title: Visit Us, Virtually | Cal Poly Events
cards.access_notes: Free and open to everyone online; the on-demand tour can be viewed without traveling to campus. Live offerings may require registration.
